reuse_count_interpretation: Prespecified amortization scenarios for measured prefill and a measured new-process cache load. R is not a claim of R observed reuse processes or R independent families.
correctness_basis: Same frozen BF16 numerical contract as Study A; compile is the intervention, not precision. Fullgraph inductor/default/dynamic=False; no silent eager fallback.
cache_contract: Dedicated study/split/family/batch/session cache, CACHE_PREFILL H=1 in separate process then new persistent-cache process. Count prefill total cost/R plus measured cache load and H forwards for each R. Persistent-hit counters required; no shared cache reuse.
claim_scope: Independent compiler/cache systems study; cannot replace Study A or claim scientific task accuracy.
missing_outcomes: No imputation; report compilation failures, cache misses, recompiles and all unstarted cells.
final_release: Same independent pilot gate as A; compile and cross-process cache correctness prequalification required. No ACRE certificate or effect-sign gate.
